- **Why no extra approval was needed:** Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so this isn't outside mail. Hollis leads the Central team and doesn't own the account, so a finance figure needs Anselm's or June's approval to go to them. As CFO, Anselm gave that approval in the request.
- **The figure isn't checked:** I used $2,356 as Anselm passed it on from Dana and didn't check it against the account records. The notes I searched didn't mention a 2027 rate, but that search ran in a reduced mode, so it doesn't show the rate isn't on file.
